method: Actual emitted page images from the exact PDF, individually inspected in small batches. Rendering and text extraction alone were not treated as visual inspection.

current_build_repair.repair: Four aligned lines replace an invalid split with multiple alignment columns; formulas are unchanged.
current_build_repair.failed_attempt_pdf: No output PDF was produced by the failed first stage; no visual review is attributed to it.

visual_observations: The first-page attribution, incomplete status and manuscript notation concordance are fully visible.
Updated C12 scope and its exact inclusion map are visible on pages 85-86.
Every page of C76-C80 was viewed; the C77.4 repair and the C80.2, C80.11-C80.13 line splits are legible.
The shared-base cutoff, endpoint formulas, compact word bounds and sphere relative subset have clear display spacing.
Every page of D76 was independently viewed, including coefficient, incidence, inverse-limit and literal involution maps.
Historical overflow passages and a spread across all six parts were inspected.
F19 ends on page 499; references begin on page 500 and end on page 508, with readable verification notes.

Viewed the dense D24 continuation. The long modular-coordinate display, powers and lower quotient equation remain within the text area; citations, inline superscripts and the footer are legible.
Viewed the D36 ending and D37 opening. The new claim heading, manuscript paragraph and D37a-d display labels have clear separation; the long setup wraps without clipping.
Viewed the repaired D37o two-line deck display: all five maps and its tag fit cleanly. The following D38 heading and three-row count table are aligned and legible.
Viewed the D51 statement and proof opening. The index/cover comparisons and Heisenberg-coordinate formulas fit; no overlap occurs between the displayed maps and equation numbers.
Viewed D62o-p and the all-unit continuation. Both basis maps and their labels fit on the line, and the continuation heading, half-exponents and two-line centralizer display are clearly separated.
Viewed the D71 integral-lattice and section-class proof. The wide coset-to-section map and the free-module map remain in bounds; summation indices, subgroup labels and body text are readable.
Viewed the D73 ending and repaired D74.1 setup. Its two-line action display fits cleanly, and D74.2-3 plus the claim text remain clear above the footer.
Viewed D74.10-16. The relative long exact sequence, coefficient pairing and duality displays are legible and bounded; labels remain clear of the formulas.
Viewed D74.38-40 and the D75 opening. The two-line all-unit conjugator equation is well spaced; the scope paragraph and next claim heading do not collide.
Viewed the D75 ending and D76 opening. The extension-map table is aligned, D75.27 is legible, and the new D76 heading and first two displays have adequate spacing.
Viewed D76.3-9. The specified incidence map/cokernel uses a readable two-line alignment, the literal generators are clear, and both inverse restriction maps fit without clipping.
Viewed D76.10-16. The coefficient short exact sequence, induction/inverse maps, explicit connecting cochain, Brown restriction and Ext comparison are all legible with unobstructed tags.

Viewed D76.17-21 in full. The finite pullback sequence, finite coinvariant formula, simple-Hom dimension formula and three inverse-limit expressions stay inside the text block; no clipped accents or labels.
Viewed D76.22-24 and its proof ending. The incidence quotient, literal products and exact generated subgroup formulas are clear. The transition into Section E has consistent hierarchy and spacing.
Viewed the E1 proof and E2 opening. The multiplication formula, three exact sequences and framed-diagram coproduct are readable; headers, proof markers and page footer remain unobstructed.
Viewed F7.20-22. The two finite quotient rows, surface-cover table and six-row Schreier table are aligned and fully visible, with legible group and cusp labels.
Viewed the F12 detector ending and F13 opening. The three homology basis vectors and winding detector are unclipped; the full kernel and source-cusp relation display correctly.
Viewed the F18 ending and F19 opening. The long Mobius-coordinate formula has its tag safely on the next line, and the initial forgetting-square diagram and fiber-product labels are legible.
Viewed F19.3-12, including the repaired F19.9. The two-line gamma/image formula fits; the commutative diagram, inverse product maps and final source-membership paragraph are clear with no overlap.
